title: Decompress Run-Length Encoded List
summary: Given a list of integers representing run-length encoded values, generate the decompressed list by repeating each value according to its frequency.
statement: Given a list of integers representing run-length encoded values, generate the decompressed list by repeating each value according to its frequency. For each pair [frequency, value], create a sublist with the value repeated frequency times, then concatenate all sublists in order.
constraints: nums has even length and stores [frequency,value] pairs.
hints: Read the input two entries at a time as count then value.
Append count copies of value for each pair.
Concatenate all expanded runs in their original order.
Each pair independently specifies exactly one output run.
editorial: Each pair independently specifies exactly one output run.

tests.explanation: One two followed by three fours gives 2,4,4,4.
One one followed by two threes gives 1,3,3.
